```{=html}
<div class="hero hero-globe">
  <div class="hero-copy">
    <div class="eyebrow">ISSS626 · Singapore Management University</div>
    <h1><span class="grad" data-text="Geospatial Analytics &amp; Applications">Geospatial Analytics &amp; Applications</span></h1>
    <p>Hi, I am Nor Hendra. This site documents my coursework in geospatial data science: hands-on exercises, in-class exercises, and take-home assignments, all built with R.</p>
    <div class="globe-actions">
      <button id="locate-btn" class="globe-btn" type="button">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="15" height="15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
             stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
          <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/>
          <path d="M12 21c-4-4.5-7-8-7-11a7 7 0 0 1 14 0c0 3-3 6.5-7 11z"/>
        </svg>
        Locate me
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="hero-globe-viz">
    <div id="globe-wrap">
      <svg id="globe" role="img" aria-label="Interactive rotating globe"></svg>
    </div>
    <div class="globe-readout">
      <span class="ro-dot"></span>
      <span id="globe-coords" class="ro-coords">1.2966° N, 103.8500° E</span>
      <span id="globe-zone" class="ro-zone">Tropical zone</span>
    </div>
    <span class="globe-hint">Drag to spin · tap to drop a pin</span>
  </div>
</div>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7/dist/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3/dist/topojson-client.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  function initGlobe() {
    if (typeof d3 === 'undefined') { setTimeout(initGlobe, 200); return; }

    var svg = d3.select('#globe');
    var wrap = document.getElementById('globe-wrap');
    if (!svg.node() || !wrap) return;

    var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    // state
    var mLon = 103.8500, mLat = 1.2966;   // default: Singapore
    var paused = false, resumeAt = 0;

    // theme colors
    function themeColors() {
      var cs = getComputedStyle(document.body);
      var g = function (n, f) { var v = cs.getPropertyValue(n).trim(); return v || f; };
      return {
        surface: g('--surface', '#ffffff'),
        teal:    g('--teal',    '#17A398'),
        tealDeep:g('--teal-deep','#0E7C74'),
        violet:  g('--violet',  '#6C5CE7'),
        cyan:    g('--cyan',    '#22D3EE'),
        line:    g('--line',    '#E4E6E1'),
        ink:     g('--ink',     '#16232B')
      };
    }
    function isDark() { return document.body.classList.contains('quarto-dark'); }

    // projection + path
    var projection = d3.geoOrthographic().clipAngle(90).precision(0.3);
    var path = d3.geoPath(projection);
    var graticule = d3.geoGraticule10();

    // svg scaffolding
    var defs = svg.append('defs');
    var oceanGrad = defs.append('radialGradient')
      .attr('id', 'oceanGrad').attr('cx', '35%').attr('cy', '30%').attr('r', '75%');
    var oStop1 = oceanGrad.append('stop').attr('offset', '0%');
    var oStop2 = oceanGrad.append('stop').attr('offset', '100%');

    var glow = defs.append('filter').attr('id', 'markerGlow')
      .attr('x', '-80%').attr('y', '-80%').attr('width', '260%').attr('height', '260%');
    glow.append('feGaussianBlur').attr('stdDeviation', '3').attr('result', 'b');
    var fm = glow.append('feMerge');
    fm.append('feMergeNode').attr('in', 'b');
    fm.append('feMergeNode').attr('in', 'SourceGraphic');

    var spherePath = svg.append('path').attr('class', 'g-sphere');
    var haloPath   = svg.append('path').attr('class', 'g-halo');
    var gratPath   = svg.append('path').attr('class', 'g-grat');
    var landPath   = svg.append('path').attr('class', 'g-land');

    var markerG = svg.append('g').attr('class', 'g-marker');
    var ring = markerG.append('circle').attr('class', 'm-ring').attr('r', 6).attr('fill', 'none');
    ring.append('animate').attr('attributeName', 'r').attr('values', '5;16').attr('dur', '2s').attr('repeatCount', 'indefinite');
    ring.append('animate').attr('attributeName', 'opacity').attr('values', '0.9;0').attr('dur', '2s').attr('repeatCount', 'indefinite');
    var dot = markerG.append('circle').attr('class', 'm-dot').attr('r', 4).attr('filter', 'url(#markerGlow)');

    var width = 0, height = 0, radius = 0;

    function applyColors() {
      var c = themeColors();
      var dark = isDark();
      oStop1.attr('stop-color', dark ? '#12262A' : '#FFFFFF');
      oStop2.attr('stop-color', dark ? '#0C1A1D' : '#E9F3F1');
      spherePath.attr('fill', 'url(#oceanGrad)').attr('stroke', c.teal).attr('stroke-opacity', dark ? 0.5 : 0.35).attr('stroke-width', 1);
      haloPath.attr('fill', 'none').attr('stroke', c.violet).attr('stroke-opacity', 0.25).attr('stroke-width', 6);
      gratPath.attr('fill', 'none').attr('stroke', c.teal).attr('stroke-opacity', dark ? 0.18 : 0.14).attr('stroke-width', 0.5);
      landPath.attr('fill', c.teal).attr('fill-opacity', dark ? 0.55 : 0.72).attr('stroke', dark ? '#0C1A1D' : '#FFFFFF').attr('stroke-opacity', 0.5).attr('stroke-width', 0.4);
      ring.attr('stroke', c.cyan).attr('stroke-width', 2);
      dot.attr('fill', c.cyan).attr('stroke', dark ? '#0C1A1D' : '#FFFFFF').attr('stroke-width', 1.5);
    }

    var landFeature = null;

    function resize() {
      width = Math.max(220, Math.min(wrap.clientWidth, 420));
      height = width;
      radius = width / 2 - 6;
      svg.attr('viewBox', '0 0 ' + width + ' ' + height)
         .attr('width', width).attr('height', height);
      projection.scale(radius).translate([width / 2, height / 2]);
      haloPath.attr('d', path({ type: 'Sphere' }));
      redraw();
    }

    function redraw() {
      spherePath.attr('d', path({ type: 'Sphere' }));
      gratPath.attr('d', path(graticule));
      if (landFeature) landPath.attr('d', path(landFeature));
      updateMarker();
    }

    function updateMarker() {
      var rot = projection.rotate();
      var center = [-rot[0], -rot[1]];
      var visible = d3.geoDistance([mLon, mLat], center) < Math.PI / 2;
      if (visible) {
        var p = projection([mLon, mLat]);
        markerG.style('display', null).attr('transform', 'translate(' + p[0] + ',' + p[1] + ')');
      } else {
        markerG.style('display', 'none');
      }
    }

    function zoneOf(lat) {
      var a = Math.abs(lat);
      if (a < 23.5) return 'Tropical zone';
      if (a < 66.5) return 'Temperate zone';
      return 'Polar zone';
    }
    function fmt(lon, lat) {
      var ns = lat >= 0 ? 'N' : 'S';
      var ew = lon >= 0 ? 'E' : 'W';
      return Math.abs(lat).toFixed(4) + '° ' + ns + ', ' + Math.abs(lon).toFixed(4) + '° ' + ew;
    }
    function updateReadout() {
      var co = document.getElementById('globe-coords');
      var zo = document.getElementById('globe-zone');
      if (co) co.textContent = fmt(mLon, mLat);
      if (zo) zo.textContent = zoneOf(mLat);
    }

    function rotateTo(lon, lat) {
      var r0 = projection.rotate();
      var target = [-lon, -lat, 0];
      if (reduceMotion) { projection.rotate(target); redraw(); return; }
      d3.transition().duration(900).tween('rotate', function () {
        var i = d3.interpolate(r0, target);
        return function (t) { projection.rotate(i(t)); redraw(); };
      });
    }

    function setMarker(lon, lat, spin) {
      mLon = lon; mLat = lat;
      updateReadout();
      if (spin) rotateTo(lon, lat); else redraw();
      paused = true; resumeAt = d3.now() + 2600;
    }

    // drag to spin, tap to drop a pin. native pointer events for mouse and touch
    var svgNode = svg.node();
    var dragging = false, activeId = null;
    var startPx = 0, startPy = 0, rotAtStart = null, moved = 0, lastPt = [0, 0];

    // map a pointer event to globe (viewBox) coordinates
    function toGlobe(e) {
      var rect = svgNode.getBoundingClientRect();
      var sx = rect.width  ? width  / rect.width  : 1;
      var sy = rect.height ? height / rect.height : 1;
      return [(e.clientX - rect.left) * sx, (e.clientY - rect.top) * sy];
    }

    svgNode.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
      dragging = true;
      activeId = e.pointerId;
      try { svgNode.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
      paused = true;
      rotAtStart = projection.rotate();
      var pt = toGlobe(e);
      startPx = pt[0]; startPy = pt[1]; moved = 0; lastPt = pt;
      svg.style('cursor', 'grabbing');
      e.preventDefault();
    }, { passive: false });

    svgNode.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
      if (!dragging || e.pointerId !== activeId) return;
      var pt = toGlobe(e);
      lastPt = pt;
      var dx = pt[0] - startPx, dy = pt[1] - startPy;
      moved = Math.max(moved, Math.hypot(dx, dy));
      var k = 75 / projection.scale();
      projection.rotate([
        rotAtStart[0] + dx * k,
        rotAtStart[1] - dy * k,
        rotAtStart[2]
      ]);
      redraw();
      e.preventDefault();
    }, { passive: false });

    function endPointer(e) {
      if (!dragging) return;
      dragging = false;
      svg.style('cursor', 'grab');
      var pt = lastPt;
      if (moved < 6) {
        var cx = width / 2, cy = height / 2;
        if (Math.hypot(pt[0] - cx, pt[1] - cy) <= radius) {
          var inv = projection.invert(pt);
          if (inv && isFinite(inv[0]) && isFinite(inv[1])) {
            setMarker(inv[0], inv[1], true);
            return;
          }
        }
      }
      paused = true; resumeAt = d3.now() + 1500;
    }
    svgNode.addEventListener('pointerup', endPointer);
    svgNode.addEventListener('pointercancel', function () {
      dragging = false;
      svg.style('cursor', 'grab');
      paused = true; resumeAt = d3.now() + 1500;
    });
    svg.style('cursor', 'grab');

    // auto-rotation
    var last = d3.now();
    d3.timer(function () {
      var now = d3.now();
      var diff = now - last; last = now;
      if (resumeAt && now > resumeAt) { paused = false; resumeAt = 0; }
      if (paused || reduceMotion) return;
      var r = projection.rotate();
      r[0] += diff * 0.008;
      projection.rotate(r);
      redraw();
    });

    // locate me
    var locateBtn = document.getElementById('locate-btn');
    if (locateBtn) {
      locateBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (!navigator.geolocation) { flashBtn('Not supported'); return; }
        flashBtn('Locating…');
        navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
          function (pos) {
            setMarker(pos.coords.longitude, pos.coords.latitude, true);
            flashBtn('Located', true);
          },
          function () { flashBtn('Unavailable'); },
          { timeout: 8000, enableHighAccuracy: false }
        );
      });
    }
    function flashBtn(msg, ok) {
      if (!locateBtn) return;
      locateBtn.classList.toggle('is-ok', !!ok);
      if (locateBtn.lastChild) locateBtn.lastChild.textContent = ' ' + msg;
      setTimeout(function () {
        if (locateBtn.lastChild) locateBtn.lastChild.textContent = ' Locate me';
        locateBtn.classList.remove('is-ok');
      }, 2200);
    }

    // recolor on theme switch
    new MutationObserver(applyColors)
      .observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });

    // boot
    applyColors();
    projection.rotate([-mLon, -15, 0]);
    updateReadout();
    resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

    // land data, fall back to wireframe if it fails
    d3.json('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/land-110m.json')
      .then(function (world) {
        landFeature = topojson.feature(world, world.objects.land);
        applyColors();
        redraw();
      })
      .catch(function () { /* keep wireframe globe */ });
  }

  if (document.readyState !== 'loading') initGlobe();
  else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initGlobe);
})();
</script>
```
